name: Rosas Residence

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway that enters from Yvonne Rd and includes a turnaround in front of the house. The site is a single-family residence in a neighborhood of similar homes. The driveway provides staging space at the front. Hedges and trees along the sides and rear may limit some sightlines and side movement. No gates are visible from the imagery.
